proposals.announcement_evidence: 20-C-2120 for additional fiscal 2021 development studies, design efforts and material for Virginia-class submarines.  This contract modification provides additional development studies and design efforts related to Virginia-class subma
proposals.lexicon_quote: Virginia Class Submarine	2013	341	Virginia Class Submarine
proposals.rationale: The record names 'Virginia-class submarines' as the subject of the work itself, which normalizes to the index name 'Virginia Class Submarine' owned by SCN BLI 2013 (lexicon_doc 341 is the shipbuilding book). This is not the platform-support pattern §3 rejects: the contractor is General Dynamics Electric Boat and the deliverable is the class's own development studies, design efforts and design-improvement material, which is exactly what the SCN Virginia Class Submarine line funds year over year. The exact string 'Virginia Class Submarine' appears at only this pe_bli; the other Virginia entries in the index are different names ('Virginia Class Support Equipment' at 0942, 'VIRGINIA Payload Module (VPM)' at 2013, 'VIRGINIA Class (VACL) Spares and Repair Parts' at 9021, 'VIRGINIA and Photonics Mast Variant (PMV)' at two RDT&E PEs), none of which the announcement names.

refute_a.reason: Money color contradicts the proposal: the only funds obligated are 'Fiscal 2020 research, development, test and evaluation (Navy) funding in the amount of $10,000,000', while BLI 2013 is an SCN shipbuilding line (lexicon_doc 341) — RDT&E money on a construction line is exactly the appropriation mismatch lens A exists to catch, and the rationale's claim that this is 'what the SCN Virginia Class Submarine line funds year over year' is unsupported by the announcement's own funding sentence; the work itself — cost-plus-fixed-fee development studies and design efforts 'to fully evaluate new technologies for Virginia-class submarines' — is RDT&E-natured, and this org's index carries an RDT&E home for it at 0604558N 'New Design SSN' (lexicon_doc 340), which owns Virginia Class Submarine development items.

refute_b.reason: Alternative owner: RDT&E PE 0604558N 'New Design SSN' (doc 340) owns two names literally prefixed 'Virginia Class Submarine ...' (lines 1008 SPU, 1009 UDPI) and is the line whose subject is Virginia-class design and design improvement, which is verbatim what the announcement buys ('development studies and design efforts related to Virginia-class submarine design and design improvements ... to fully evaluate new technologies'); the untruncated text obligates fiscal 2020 research, development, test and evaluation (Navy) funds of $10,000,000 — not SCN — so the same bare-platform evidence links the award better to 0604558N than to SCN BLI 2013, and 0942 'Virginia Class Support Equipment' and 9021 'VIRGINIA Class (VACL) Spares' are further Virginia-named claimants; the match is on the platform string alone, which no index row makes unique to 2013.
